QuestInfo.name: Talking Tree's Request 2
QuestInfo.0: The #bTalking Tree#k on the #bShining Forest Path in Ellinia#k has a request.
QuestInfo.1: The Talking Tree seems to be very sad. It thinks it's not growing because it's too smart. It wants to make the other trees smart, so they can't grow either.\n\n#i2004041##t2004041#  #b#c2004041# / 5#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave a potion to a Talking Tree.

0.0: So, potions didn't make me any taller... The other trees are so tall. Why aren't I growing? I've thought about this long and hard, and I figured it out.
0.1: I'm too smart! The other trees just stand there and can't even talk, but I can talk and think. That's got to be it, right?

yes.0: Well, if I can't make myself taller, I'll make the other trees shorter! If I feed them Intelligence Potions, they'll become smarter, and then they'll be as short as me! Okay, I need an Intelligence Potion II.
yes.1: I heard that #bIntelligence Potions II#k can only be made by an Alchemist... Surely you know an Alchemist, right?

no.0: Hmm... What's your theory then? Maybe you should leave the thinking to me.

1.0: Do you have it? Thank you! Okay, just pour it all over!

yes.0: If there are more talking trees, you humans might leave me alone for once.

item.0: No #bIntelligence Potion II#k yet? If you drank one yourself, you might know that you need Alchemy skill to craft it. Why don't you just buy one from an Alchemist?
